note: Presentation jump points for ArUco Detection Review. Each point is re-checked against the prepared media when the page loads; a point that no longer matches is disabled, not shown with a misleading label.

jump_points.title: Close-up detected
jump_points.caption: Moving camera, close-up: ArUco finds marker ID 0. The outline and numbered corners come from the detection CSV for this exact frame.

jump_points.title: Detection lost
jump_points.caption: Fixed camera, pitch tilt: the marker is almost edge-on to the camera and ArUco does not detect it. No outline is drawn and no value is invented.

jump_points.title: Roll tilt detected
jump_points.caption: Fixed camera, roll tilt: the deck turns toward the camera and ArUco finds marker ID 0 again.

jump_points.title: Marker detached
jump_points.caption: The marker card has fallen onto the table. ArUco still detects ID 0, but a manual frame-by-frame review marks this stretch as invalid for vessel tracking.

jump_points.title: Floating vessel, marker detected
jump_points.caption: Water tank, handheld and approximately stationary camera: the tethered vessel floats untouched and ArUco finds marker ID 0.

jump_points.title: Hand-guided movement, marker detected
jump_points.caption: Water tank: the vessel is moved by hand and marker ID 0 is still detected. Detection status and corners only; no roll, pitch or stability value is derived.

jump_points.title: Marker visible, detection lost
jump_points.caption: Water tank: the marker is in view and not covered, but ArUco does not detect it from 43.44 s to 49.16 s; its black border appears faded on one side. No outline is drawn and no value is invented.

jump_points.title: Tilted marker, intermittent detection
jump_points.caption: Water tank: the marker is strongly foreshortened. From 55.28 s to 60.12 s detection flickers on and off (62 of 117 frames); this frame is one where it is not detected.
